shortDescription: Runs templates and workflow actions in Radware vDirect server

options.name: action_name
options.description: Workflow action name to run. Required if I(runnable_type=Workflow).

options.name: parameters
options.description: Action parameters dictionary. In case of C(ConfigurationTemplate) runnable type, the device connection details should always be passed as a parameter.

options.name: runnable_name
options.description: vDirect runnable name to run. May be configuration template name, workflow template name or workflow instance name.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated, may be set as C(VDIRECT_VALIDATE_CERTS) or C(VDIRECT_VERIFY) environment variable. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vdirect_http_port
options.description: vDirect server HTTP port number, may be set as C(VDIRECT_HTTP_PORT) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_https_port
options.description: vDirect server HTTPS port number, may be set as C(VDIRECT_HTTPS_PORT) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_ip
options.description: Primary vDirect server IP address, may be set as C(VDIRECT_IP) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_password
options.description: vDirect server password, may be set as C(VDIRECT_PASSWORD) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_secondary_ip
options.description: Secondary vDirect server IP address, may be set as C(VDIRECT_SECONDARY_IP) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_timeout
options.description: Amount of time to wait for async operation completion [seconds], may be set as C(VDIRECT_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection, may be set as C(VDIRECT_HTTPS) or C(VDIRECT_USE_SSL) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_user
options.description: vDirect server username, may be set as C(VDIRECT_USER) environment variable.

options.name: vdirect_wait
options.description: Wait for async operation to complete, may be set as C(VDIRECT_WAIT) environment variable.
